title: TrendSignal
description: A technical-analysis signal REFRAMED as a LEARNED, receipted signal whose EVIDENCE is the order-flow mechanism -- never a static chart-pattern match (estate disciplines: metaphor->mechanism, learn-don't-match). Three schools are grounded, not matched: Dow theory (trend + accumulation/distribution -> inventory-cycle evidence), Edwards-Magee (support/resistance -> LOB-depth evidence), and Elliott Wave (a wave_count -> MEASURED self-similarity across scale). Elliott's 'degrees' are scales; its self-similar recursion is Mandelbrot multifractal structure. The structural vocabulary is Buckminster Fuller's Synergetics cycle grammar: a cycle is a convergence to a frequency magnitude, tunable at a vertex, with a FINITE alphabet of fundamental closures {tetra_3, octa_4, icosa_5}. 'frequency' = scale/degree (same axis as the memory-regime multifractal spectrum, reused BY REFERENCE, not renamed); 'tunability' = the resolution/vertex the cycle is read at. This makes wave-counting a finite, testable structural vocabulary rather than a subjective count.

school.description: Which TA school's metaphor is being grounded in mechanism.

provenance.description: KE-contract provenance class. A 'learned' signal MUST carry mechanism evidence.

evidence.description: Mechanism-grounded evidence. Which block is REQUIRED depends on signal_type (enforced by the validator): trend->order_flow_persistence; support_resistance->lob_depth; volume_confirmation->arrival_intensity; wave_count->self_similarity + cycle_closure.

order_flow_persistence.description: Signed-order-flow persistence: Hurst H>0.5 OR a Hawkes branching ratio n>0. The mechanism a 'trend' must carry.

lob_depth.description: Limit-order-book depth at a level. The mechanism a 'support/resistance' must carry.

arrival_intensity.description: Arrival-intensity elevation. The mechanism a 'volume-confirms' must carry.

self_similarity.description: MEASURED scale-invariance for an Elliott wave_count: multifractal-spectrum width and/or cross-scale Hurst consistency. spectrum_ref binds to the memory-mesh MemoryRegimeCharacterization multifractal spectrum BY REFERENCE (not reimplemented).

cycle_closure.description: Buckminster Fuller Synergetics cycle grammar. A cycle converges to a frequency magnitude at a tunable vertex; the fundamental closures are FINITE {tetra_3 (3 events), octa_4 (4), icosa_5 (5)} -- Fuller's three omni-triangulated stable closures, 'no other fundamental cycles'. Elliott alignment: 3-wave correction = tetra_3, 5-wave impulse = icosa_5, full 8 = tetra+icosa (Fibonacci 3,5,8,13 falls out). event_count MUST match the closure and lie in {3,4,5}.

frequency.description: = scale/degree; binds to the memory-regime multifractal-spectrum scale axis BY REFERENCE.

tunability.description: = the resolution/vertex the cycle is read at.

fibonacci_claim.description: A Fibonacci retracement/extension ratio treated as a FALSIFIABLE scaling hypothesis (0.382 / 0.618 / 1.618), tested against the measured retracement -- NOT assumed. |claimed - measured| > tolerance is flagged.

receipt.description: Proof-artifact-spine SHA-256 hash-chain link (FIPS-180-4 algorithm; NOT a FIPS-140 module claim).
